# Bosnia and Herzegovina

[global-law](../) / Bosnia and Herzegovina

9 repositories under this folder (1 legislation, whole country, 8 legislation, subdivisions). Each row links to the repository's current `main`; the folder of the same path is the submodule global-law pins and reads. "Coverage" is what the corpus says of itself; freshness is global-law's monitor.

## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 17% | 29% | 62% | 0% |

Thin coverage of the essentials: the state repository holds 199 of the 681 laws listed in Službeni glasnik BiH (almost nothing from 1997-2009), and every act is held as enacted. The Constitution lacks Amendment I (2009). The state Criminal Code is an unofficial English text to 47/14 that misses at least the 2015 and 2018 amendments. The Criminal Procedure Code, both entity criminal codes, the Law on Obligations and the Federation Constitution are not held, and there is no case law.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
